data.body: [P2] Freeze each record before placing it on the asynchronous queue. Records can contain live mutable values, notably `executionResult` or objects returned by content/result transforms, while `deepCopy()` currently occurs only when the worker eventually exports them. Under backpressure, later mutation can therefore change an earlier snapshot and make Workflow Insight disagree with the already-serialized durable result. Deep-copy or otherwise detach mutable record content during enqueue, and add a test that mutates content before a delayed worker runs.
